name: r3-myweb

images.prompt:
Screen: SCRIPTURE WEB in 'My Web' mode, landscape phone (19.5:9). The same arc-diagram idea, but only the reader's own saved links are drawn: about twenty clear arcs over the 66-book baseline (tiny labels GEN ... REV), each arc in the reader's highlight colour; the segmented control shows 'My Web' selected; a side panel lists recent links: 'John 3:3 ↔ Volume One · Letter 15', 'Matthew 12:25 ↔ Volume One · Letter 15', 'Isaiah 53:5 ↔ 1 Peter 2:24'; a count '23 links you made'.
Render in the DARK theme exactly like Image 1.
Render as a crisp, flat, full-bleed Android phone screen UI mockup, front view, LANDSCAPE orientation (19.5:9), no hands, no desk, no perspective, no device photo; very thin rounded phone outline at most. Real, legible, correctly spelled text. Professional product-design quality (Apple Design Award / Material Design showcase level). Calm, reverent, uncluttered; strong typographic hierarchy; generous whitespace; consistent 8-pt spacing; touch targets at least 48 dp; WCAG AA contrast. No emoji, no stock photos, no people, no crosses or church clip-art, no logos.
TEXT FIDELITY (strict): use ONLY the exact wording supplied in this spec for any scripture, letter, lyric or dedication text. Wherever the layout needs more running text than supplied, render it as soft grey placeholder lines (greeked bars), never as readable sentences. Never write new sentences attributed to God, the Bible, the letters or the songs. UI labels may be written freely.
